title: Purple Mage Sorceress
description: A young female character with light purple hair in an updo stands in a dynamic pose against a solid gray background. She wears a white and purple traditional-style outfit with a corset top, flowing sleeves, and wide pants, while casting glowing purple magic from both hands with crescent moon and swirling energy effects around her.
prompt: A young East Asian female sorceress with pale lavender hair in an ornate updo and glowing purple energy crown, wearing a detailed white and purple traditional fantasy outfit with corset, wide flowing pants and sash, dynamically posed casting powerful purple magic from both hands, one hand emitting a swirling crescent moon spell and the other a crackling energy orb, against a plain dark gray background, clean anime illustration style
